name: Bensenville (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of purple-blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing a stylised letter B in blue and navy blue.
history: Bensenville is a village located near O'Hare International Airport in DuPage County, Illinois, with a portion of the town in Cook County. The flag was adopted in 2018 (unveiled in July 2018, according to Flags of the World citing the Chicago Tribune).

features.role: disc with a stylised letter B
